notes: New: Firm Sync (Settings > Firm Sync) shares staff logins and the client list across all PCs of a firm, end-to-end encrypted. New: GST Tracker 'Sync all not-filed' re-checks only clients with a pending or not-filed return, plus 'Sync everyone' and a per-client refresh. Fix: activating a license on a new PC no longer fails with 'no such table: app_settings'.
